description: Somos entusiastas de la tecnología, la ciencia y la exploración espacial. Nos motiva la robótica y la programación especialmente los proyectos relacionados con la NASA. Nos gusta aprender cómo funcionan las cosas, crear soluciones tecnológicas y experimentar con nuevas ideas para resolver desafíos del espacio y nuestro planeta. ¡Queremos aprender y crear juntos!
summary: It is a junior astronaut simulator—an educational experience developed in Unity and C# that invites young explorers to confront the challenges of living on Mars. Through a series of missions, players explore the Martian environment, identify valuable resources, and make decisions to build and maintain a habitable base.
details:
Cybersantic cultivates critical thinking and scientific curiosity in children, using NASA data to teach them that every decision on Mars carries real consequences.

Mission 1: Players must respond to a solar storm by determining how best to protect the base. Their decisions affect energy and food supplies, while the astronaut’s suit reflects the hazards of radiation.

Mission 2: Players respond to a water-related emergency by choosing whether to repair a leak, ignore it, or increase irrigation, then experience the consequences for the base’s resources and security. Greenhouse activities introduce plant cultivation and energy management, including recharging the base’s generator.

The simulator integrates science, problem-solving, and environmental awareness through its gameplay mechanics. It also incorporates NASA DONKI data to provide information about space weather and help players understand its relevance to missions. The ultimate goal is to reach the return rocket and complete the mission.
